name: dnstwister.report domain-fuzzing API
operator: dnstwister project (open-source code at github.com/thisismyrobot/dnstwister); since 2026-11 its homepage redirects to the commercial dnstwister.com
tier_rationale: P012 cond 11 sets the opt-in dnstwister adapter to community tier: an identifiable open-source project with public API documentation and a public track record since 2015 (A8 community). The brand sent to it is disclosed to a third party, so the adapter is opt-in and excluded at TLP:AMBER and above.

reliability.justification: Deterministic dnstwist-style permutations only; registration and activity facts are checked by V3LUM itself through the core DoH resolver, never taken from dnstwister.

fuzz.title: dnstwister.report /api/fuzz/{domain_hex} (permutation list of one domain)
fuzz.notes: Research C0028 recorded the terms as 'Free public service (open-source project)' on 2026-11-25; on 2026-11-26 https://dnstwister.report/ answered 301 to https://dnstwister.com/, a commercial monitoring product with a pricing page and no published terms for the free API (the API itself still answers). Terms stay 'unknown' (disabled in every licence profile, A1) until legal records them (doctor --licences). Only /api/fuzz/{hex} is called, once per brand: never /api/parked/ (dnstwister would fetch the lookalike), /api/whois/, /api/ip/ or /api/mx/ (P012 cond 11).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G01-2 (P012 cond 11, module typosquat_dnstwister). One fuzz call per brand: 7-day cache (deterministic output), 2 s between requests; the ~125 KB answer for example.com needs a generous max_bytes.
